answer: An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Because a fabricated citation fails the willow check immediately, the harbor audit keeps the resolved set and the sparrow replay shows exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 169 aliases hence burns the reading cost 169 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
